rationale: The chick-success ratio may share its breeding-pair denominator with the November adult census. Test an orthogonal endpoint based only on January chick counts before any chick-data outcome is opened.

response.annual_transition: diff(log1p num_chicks) for adjacent breeding seasons with both colony rows observed
response.zero_rule: retain positive-to-zero and zero-to-positive; exclude zero-to-zero
response.eligibility: island-specific colony_code with >=3 informative transitions and non-zero temporal SD
response.standardization: z-standardize informative annual chick-count growth within colony
response.regional_residualization: subtract the season-end mean standardized growth across all eligible colonies observed that transition

statistic: Mean residual product for same-island colony-pair × transition records minus mean residual product for different-island pairs.

null.labels: Static observed island labels permuted within five deterministic strata ranked by number of informative chick transitions, then mean log1p chick abundance, then stable identifier.
null.test: two-sided permutation p; support also requires positive observed contrast

interpretation_boundaries: A positive result cannot be generated solely by reuse of the adult breeding-pair denominator because num_chicks is the only response.
The chick census itself may still contain shared island-year observation effects or shared census timing.
Do not change transition rules, eligibility, transform, strata, permutations, or island sensitivity after outcomes are opened.
